programme.title: Animal Atlas
programme.desc: This educational series takes viewers on a journey around the world to meet all kinds of animals, from the familiar to the not-so-familiar. "Animal Atlas" teaches viewers about the animals' lives, histories and adaptations that allow them to survive in their environment. Whether it's visiting monkeys or heading underwater for a look at mammals that live in the ocean, "Animal Atlas" brings animals from around the globe into viewers' homes for an up-close look at how the animals live.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Little Singham
programme.desc: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies.

programme.title: Life Of A Predator
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: Wolves: Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From the Arctic tundra to the Great Plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire Northern Hemisphere; wolves are icons of the wilderness and spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: Located at the intersection of the Drava and Danube rivers, a wetland ecosystem remains concealed behind the iron curtain, having been largely undiscovered.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions
programme.desc: The filmmaker delves into the fascinating life of five young lions residing in the Masai Mara reserve in Kenya while highlighting the threats they face such as poaching and habitat loss.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in "Natural Born Monsters." When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: Hippo King
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the life, challenges and survival tactics of an old hippo bull from the Luangwa valley of Zambia.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.desc: The filmmaker unearths Sri Lanka's most biologically diverse ecosystem that is packed with the stealthiest and most ferocious animal kingdom like leopards and giant sea creatures.

programme.title: A Night on Earth: Africa
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the captivating nocturnal adventures of different animals after dusk falls on the African savanna.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: The Teeth of the Savannah
programme.desc: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there.

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.desc: The filmmaker examines the behaviour of lions and hyenas, challenging preconceived notions about their supposed rivalry.

programme.title: Big Cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of a lion and cheetah family as they struggle to survive amidst climate change in Serengeti.

programme.title: Big Cat Tales
programme.desc: The team documents the daily life and struggle of families of different species of big cats as they strive to hunt, mate, defend territories and bring up their young in the wild.

programme.title: Rise Of Jaguars
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the most formidable predators in the world.

programme.title: Golden Eagle: Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: Wild Kashmir
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: The filmmaker documents the conflict between various species of the animal kingdom and understands the motives behind the rivalry.

programme.title: Big Cats Small World
programme.desc: Three big cat families have made Botswana's Gomoti River their home and use their skills to outsmart predators and rivals while co-existing in a shared space.

programme.title: Nature's Fast Attacks
programme.desc: The filmmaker travels across the world to document nature's greatest predators as they use their speed and agility to chase and strike their prey.

programme.title: Surviving Australia
programme.desc: Survivors recount harrowing escapes from the Australian outback, while experts dismantle common myths to provide the raw tactics needed to stay alive.

programme.title: Rise Of Jaguars
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the top predators in the world.

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides a deep dive into the unique wildlife habitat that is thriving in the Danube riverbank forests ecosystem in the heart of Europe.

programme.title: River Monsters

programme.title: Life Of A Predator
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: Wolves: Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: At the confluence of the Drava and Danube rivers lies one of Central Europe's best-kept secrets: an inland delta. Concealed behind the Iron Curtain for 50 years, this pristine wetland ecosystem has remained largely untouched and unexplored.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions
programme.desc: In a journey that follows lions for the first five years of their lives, uncover fascinating insights into the lives of these majestic animals and discover the threats against them, such as poaching and habitat loss.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: The Hippo King
programme.desc: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.desc: For its size, Sri Lanka is one of the most biologically diverse places on Earth.

programme.title: Night on Earth: Africa
programme.desc: Exploring the incredible odyssey and nocturnal adventures of African elephants, who must migrate across wild and dangerous terrain in order to survive.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: The Teeth of the Savannah
programme.desc: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there.

programme.title: Lions Versus Hyenas

programme.title: Big Cats of the Serengeti

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. While exploring the evolution of these mammals over the years Aryee also examines how these feline creatures have survived harsh environments, becoming king of the jungle as well as being a popular household pet. Cats are celebrated for their physical prowess, with their running, jumping and climbing skills second to no other animal in the world. Species featured on the show include caracals jumping to reach their prey, Siberian tigers in their natural landscape and rare footage reveals Bornean bay cats in action.

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Disturbing yet empowering accounts of how people have escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: The Mind Control Freaks
programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. The show features master manipulators, including professional poker player Liv Boeree and mentalism expert Lewis Le Val, who use their abilities to influence others' actions. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning "Deadliest Catch," follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Disturbing yet empowering accounts of how people have escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: The Mind Control Freaks
programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. The show features master manipulators, including professional poker player Liv Boeree and mentalism expert Lewis Le Val, who use their abilities to influence others' actions. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning "Deadliest Catch," follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked.
